newsitem.title: UK: Lehman cuts US, raises UK in global equity fund.
newsitem.headline: Lehman cuts US, raises UK in global equity fund.

text.p: Lehman Brothers global strategist Joe Rooney has cut exposure to the U.S. and raised his holdings in the UK in the latest asset allocation shift for his dollar based global equity portfolio.

Rooney, just returned from the U.S. to London on Monday, said he did not see any further easing in interest rates in the U.S. for the time being and had cut the model portfolio weighting to 33 percent from 45 percent.
The UK was raised from six percent to 15 percent. Other changes were a downgrading of Sweden from overweight to neutral and Hong Kong to underweight from neutral.
"Hong Kong loses partly on our view of the U.S. and partly on stretched valuations," Rooney said.
The fund "broadly" takes the FT-World Index as its benchmark but adjusts that to take account of the aggregate of market capitalisations, he added. Holdings are unhedged.
He has no cash as the fund is always 100 percent invested.
